address: 40 E. 20th St., New York, NY, 10003, USA
bio: Behind a modest Flatiron storefront, LenLen opens into a lively dining room inspired by 1970s Bangkok shophouses, complete with vintage televisions, family photographs and retro touches. The cocktail program is as thoughtful as the kitchen, turning out bright, aromatic drinks that pair naturally with the food. The menu draws from a range of Thai traditions while embracing modern influences. Highlights include a beef tartare larb wrapped in endive and perilla leaves, and a rich crab curry that balances sweetness, spice and coconut milk with surprising finesse. Open late, LenLen feels equally suited for dinner or a spontaneous night out.
